application_fix.detail: Clone Dusk XML in memory and replace exactly one missing Env Spec Texture reference with official QualityLow DDS, proven loadable by native ResourceProbe. Installed XML and public cache are unchanged.

remaining.DaySpecularHDR.dds: Requested at engine bootstrap before app Lua, and when Zone is first created. Cannot repair that pre-Lua request through app configuration. QualityLow asset exists.
remaining.themis_x64.dll: Dynamically loaded engine SDK string is present, not a static PE import, not bundled in the eight-file official runtime archive. Tested local gameplay runs despite load failure. Exact SDK purpose/publishing impact undocumented; no dummy DLL or install.

privacy.original_install_logs: Four known first-session game/lua logs remain in the original Runtime install directory; no deletion or alteration.
privacy.credential_pattern_scan: No matches for tested access-token/password/API-key/JWT/Bearer patterns. This is not proof of no sensitive data.
privacy.sensitive_content: Game logs contain Windows user paths, GPU details and loopback preview URLs with opaque 64-character path segments. Raw logs are not uploaded or committed; exact opaque values are not copied to reports.
privacy.related_User_ResCache: Metadata only inspected for attribution. User-state/credential file contents not read.
privacy.scope: Read-only audit of task-owned known logs; unrelated user state cannot be attributed by timestamp alone.
